correctness.rationale: Unique binary greedy-arch factorization partitions every half-word into arches 0^a1 or 1^a0, followed by empty or constant rest. The established palindrome center criterion identifies the even index 2r and the exact odd +1 condition. Paired length/one weights and index weights give geometric arch series H, disjoint even and odd tail series and the asserted rational identity. The zero-arch and empty-word boundaries are covered. Exact polynomial recurrence matches exhaustive mirror-palindrome coefficient triples for 0<=n<=20, and independent all-subsequence tests for n<=12; the proof rather than these finite checks gives the infinite claim.

value.rationale: The formula supplies exact joint counts for all lengths, Hamming weights and scattered-subsequence universality indices in a natural reversal-constrained language. Fixed composition is structurally motivated by constrained pattern synthesis, and cannot be determined numerically from an unweighted full-word distribution or shortest-palindrome lengths. It exposes nontrivial content-sensitive index distributions (for n=16, j=8 the nonzero index counts are 2,16,36,16). Complete closed rational enumeration at all lengths is substantive beyond a small computed slice.
